steps.content: Grim walls bear marks of struggle, in shades of black and red, while the small window, sealed with planks, lets no light in.
Rings of cages surround a heap of junk in the middle, and it almost feels like you can smell the damp, rotting stench.
Here, the performers playing "prisoners" seem off compared to the ones you met a while ago; their tranquil, numb gaze is strangely unsettling.
Watching them closely, you can't miss the iron chains on their wrists. Even when let out, they're still bound too close to their "cells" to really go anywhere.
Is this so-called "leader" actually here?

steps.speaker: Culprit A
steps.content: See for yourself, this place is teeming with poor souls!
Being nudged along from the ring's edge, you walk inwards. With every person you pass, they lean in to share their tales of woe.

steps.speaker: Culprit A
steps.content: I'm damned for my sins! But what did I do? Just snatched some bread from the back door in hunger!

steps.speaker: Culprit B
steps.content: I'm damned for my sins! But all I did was mistakenly flip my knife while embracing a friend.

steps.speaker: Culprit C
steps.content: I'm damned for my sins! But my only crime was dozing off while feeding my little brother—I hadn't had any sleep for three days.

steps.speaker: Culprit C
steps.content: Oh, and when I woke up, his face was still covered in that spilled porridge.

steps.speaker: Culprits
steps.content: This place is teeming with poor souls, damned poor souls!

steps.speaker: Culprits
steps.content: The further in you go, the more unfair it gets!

steps.speaker: Culprits
steps.content: Absolutely, absolutely! The one in the center of the prison is the most wronged, the most tragic of us all!

steps.speaker: Culprits
steps.content: She'll reveal her ordeal under the spotlight, she'll be the one to guide us past those brick walls!

steps.speaker: Culprits
steps.content: She's the most wronged of us all! The most sorrowful! The focal point!
It's like a relay inside the cages, everyone going as far as they can go, moving you, Ignis, and the audience, one by one, toward that junk-filled center of the cages.
They're serenading the crowd, all eyes on the center, where the spotlight never leaves, like it's waiting for someone special to show up.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: Ch... Chief, that was quite a show, nearly scared me there.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: This feels completely different from what we saw before.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I thought the earlier acts were top-notch, but this... this takes it to a whole new level.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: This makes me curious about the "leader" they keep talking about.
Looks like everyone's thinking the same. They're all gathered around the center, necks craned, waiting to see what kind of showstopper the next act will be.
Oh, the most sorrowful—the most wronged—yes, that has to be me!
A sweet voice you are too familiar cuts through the air—then, whoosh, all the spotlights focus on the heap of junk before you.
The sound of footsteps, getting louder and closer, and then, surprise! Someone you'd never guess shows up on top of the cage!

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: I'm damned for my sins! Simply because my hair colors are different!

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: I'm damned for my sins! Just because my eyes aren't the same color!

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: I'm damned for my sins! Only because I am not the same as everyone else!
On top of the cage, Luvia Ray, shaky and faltering, strikes three unique poses. In her last one, she raises her head, as though ready to hug the air, and reaches out her arms to you.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: Chief, is it just me, or are Luvia's eyes twitching...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Well, to me, it seems like she's giving us the evil eye...

The crowd around the center cage shares a look of bewilderment. In contrast to the earlier act, which is profound and compelling, instantly drawing the audience into its weighty atmosphere, the "leader" appears to be... oddly out of place.

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: <size=28> Hey... at least show me some reaction. Chief! Ignis!</size>

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: <size=28>It's fine even if you just clap your hands!</size>
Soft murmurs, as if forced through gritted teeth, float across the air, catching your and Ignis's attention.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: O-Oh, wow! That's nice!

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: Uh, I don't mean what happened to you is nice. I mean, it's... it's really well... well played...

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: Oh! Now—I can feel others' sympathy for me! Truly! It's such a rare sight!
Luvia Ray walks down to join your side. Like a mythical roc unfolding its grand wings, she gestures at the actor delivering the opening line.

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: She is set on proving that she has no clue the bread stacked at the back door isn't meant to be thrown away!
After another swift turn, Luvia Ray takes hold of the hand of the actor who performs the second line.

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: He has to prove that it was someone else who pushed his friend onto him!
Noticing Luvia Ray struggling to come up with a third gesture, the actress who delivered the third line approaches her and kindly takes her hand.

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: No one knew that while she was feeding her little brother breakfast, she hadn't slept for three days, she worked non-stop—

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: And then there's me, the poor me!
Luvia Ray approaches you and Ignis once more, enveloping both of you in a heartfelt embrace.

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: A charming girl with a passion for performing, so talented in her craft, they treated her as a Sinner and threw her into a prison, mistaking her act for reality!

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: But you are a...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: This... is this scripted too?
Luvia Ray nestles herself between you and Ignis, whispering in hushed tones as if sharing a secret.

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: <size=30>Hehe, of course it is!</size>

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: <size=30>I'll tell you guys a secret: The lady from the Fortuna Theater came to me earlier, she said she was impressed with my performance mingling with the other actors.</size>

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: <size=30>So she decided to make me the star of this show!</size>
Though she's trying to keep it down, you can't miss the thrill in Luvia Ray's voice.

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: <size=30>I'm finally the star of the show for once. Chief, Ignis, play along with me this time, please~</size>
When your Sinner herself is pitching in, how can you say no?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Sure, no problem.
You softly tap Luvia Ray's hand that's draped over your shoulder.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Alright, our star, time to break you out of this prison!
